text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The Confederation of Trade Unions (KOZ) said the 1997 state budget was unacceptable as it failed to take into account an expected worsening of the social and economic situation of the population. KOZ said it would present its amendments to the draft in parliament.

- Deputy Agriculture Minister Marian Lipka rejected media reports on an expected 20 percent increase in food prices next year. But Lipka admitted that prices could dramaticaly increase if the state eased its regulatory policy.
- The trade union at steel producer VSZ has stopped paying its dues to the OZ KOVO, the steel and engineering trade union, saying it was considering quiting OZ KOVO.

- Some 9,005 cars were sold in Slovakia in October, increasing the overall volume of new cars sold in the first 10 months of this year to 55,528. The most successful car producer in the January-August period was the Czech Skoda, which sold 17,004 units, accounting for 30.6 percent of the market.

- The parliamentary club of the ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS) said the resignation of former club member and HZDS deputy Frantisek Gaulider was a betrayal on people who elected him to parliament and that it expected him hand back his mandate.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The law on the creation of the state export-import bank is expected to be approved by parliament by the end of this year, so that the bank could start activities from the beginning of next year.

- An inflow of foreign capital through direct purchases of hard currencies from foreign banks on the interbank foreign exchange market totalled 0.9 billion crowns in September, increasing the overal volume of inflow to four billion crowns since the beginning of this year.

- Harmanecke Papierne a.s., a major producer of hygienic paper, expects its turnover to total some 1.1 billion crowns this year and gross profit to be 30-40 billion crowns. The company, accounting for 70 percent of the domestic market, will this year export 34 percent of its production to the Czech Republic.

- VSZ Ocel, a member of the VSZ Group, plans modernisation worth some 393 million crowns by the end of this year to increase its production of packaging sheet steel to 140,000 tonnes a year from the current capacity of 110,000 tonnes.

SME - HZDS deputy Frantisek Gaulider said he believed he was being followed by unknown persons. Gaulider said he was not sure whether his shadows were from the secret service (SIS) or another state body, but added he had doubts statements from the SIS and interior ministry which both denied involvement.
